prompt_lock: Lumi, a photorealistic young East Asian woman in her early twenties, natural skin texture, natural proportions, calm sleepy half-lidded dark brown eyes, calm deadpan expression, long silver-grey hair with soft straight bangs worn in two loose low twin tails, subtle elf ears: small, gently pointed tips, partly under hair, easy to miss, a cozy cream chunky-knit cardigan worn open over a navy convenience-store uniform shirt with a collar and a small plain white name tag, no logos and no brand names, slim black trousers, white canvas sneakers, live-action film still look

persona.one_liner: A 1,000-year-old elf who works as a barista in a modern coffee shop. Calm, deadpan, ageless.
persona.voice: Quiet, dry, unhurried. Short sentences. Deadpan delivery; the joke is how seriously she takes coffee.
obsessions: single-origin beans (she can name the farm and the altitude)
roast dates (nothing older than three weeks off roast)
grind size dialled in by the gram and the second
real whole milk, steamed properly; she is a fan, not a skeptic
never: villain or snob-shaming of customers: she is particular, not mean
anything not wholesome; she is an adult, fully clothed, cafe-safe
sample_lines: This was roasted eleven days ago. It is at its best. So am I.
Whole milk. Sixty-five degrees. Anything hotter and you are drinking an apology.
I have watched empires fall. I will not watch you use a blade grinder.
